M/ Machinist GitHub

Local control plane for coding agents

Build a workflow.
Let the agents run it.

Machinist turns reusable prompts into direct or managed coding-agent runs, while commands, repositories, and credentials stay on your machines.

Get started View source
$ go install github.com/owainlewis/machinist/cmd/machinist@latest
01

Define the work once

Keep agents, prompts, models, and ordered pipelines in strict, reviewable configuration.

02

Run locally or managed

Execute in the current worktree or submit durable jobs to workers through the local control plane.

03

Keep machine authority local

Workers resolve logical names into local commands, repository paths, environments, and credentials.

A deliberate boundary

“The control plane sends intent. The worker owns machine authority.”

One Go binary includes the CLI, control plane, managed worker, SQLite state, and browser interface. No hosted account is required.
